nom: KONEUK 14 Pack Sheet Face Masks Skincare

segments.sensitive: Reports from sensitive-skin reviewers are sharply divided: several describe the masks as gentle, soothing, and safe for sensitive skin, while three others describe serious reactions — facial swelling, rash, and an eye swollen shut in one case — severe enough to need medical treatment or steroid cream.
segments.dry: The one reviewer pairing sensitive and dry skin found it left her skin fresh and supple.
segments.oily: The one reviewer describing oily, greasy skin sometimes notices a pimple the day after use, but attributes this to skipping her own moisturizer in summer rather than to the mask.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report an immediate hydration boost — soft, plump, refreshed skin right after use — though one reviewer notes the effect is light and doesn't last, seeing no real difference after multiple uses.
concerns.redness: While many reviewers describe a calming, cooling effect with no irritation, three reviewers report serious reactions to specific masks in the set (aloe, shea butter) — facial swelling, rash, and in one case an eye swollen shut — severe enough to require antihistamines, steroid cream, or medical attention.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports it doesn't cause breakouts at all, while another sometimes notices a pimple the day after use, though she attributes that to not following up with a moisturizer rather than to the mask itself.

aspects.libelle: Wide variety of scents and ingredients across the set
Generously soaked, plenty of leftover essence
Strong value for the price per mask
Sheet can be tricky to unfold, sticks to itself
Some boxes arrive already opened, though contents intact

extraits.titre: BE AWARE- CAN CAUSE INFLAMMATION, Chemical Burn!
extraits.texte: BE AWARE!! Purchased these masks for the first time and gave as gifts. Thankfully I was the only one to use them. In less than 24 hours of using the Aloe mask, my face began to itch. Went to bed and woke up the next day with a swollen face, onset of a rash and one eye swollen almost shut. Tried over the counter methods, but they didn’t work. Went to bed, woke up on day two and rash had increased, left eye now swollen and face on fire. An outline of the mask can be seen on my face, particularly the forehead area. I’ve used many masks (different brands) and have NEVER had a reaction like this. Required medical attention to stop and treat the negative effects of the mask.

Do not use if you have sensitive skin , or maybe not at all. I bought these for a slumber party and had a few extra so I did them with the girls. I had a horrible allergic reaction/ maybe chemical burn. It I he’s and hurts at the same time. My niece used one and took it off right away said it burns. I have added pictures this is after Benadryl and prescription steroid cream.

I have sensitive skin and these are so gentle on my skin. The masks are durable yet delicate not too thick at all. They also smell really good. My skin feels the different benefits from each one. People always tell me how great my skin looks since I have used them. All my girls love them. I will be buying these until I die. Definitely worth the money 56 collagen enriched mask for $25 is a steal.
Great for sensitive, dry skin. Leaves your skin feeling fresh and supple. Its a sheet masks soaked in a thick serum.

extraits.titre: Hydrating masks but results are lightHydrating masks but results are light
extraits.texte: I have been using these sheet masks for a few days and they feel very refreshing on the skin. They are easy to use and the packaging is nice. What I liked: they leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated right after use. The masks have a pleasant scent and are relaxing. What I didn’t like: the results do not last very long, and I did not see a big difference after multiple uses. Also, the mask can feel a little slippery. Good size and value for the money. Overall, these are good for a quick hydration boost, but not for long-term results. I hope this review helps.

I use this almost daily. Very relaxing and hydrating. It doesn’t make me breakout at all. I didn't smell any fragrance. I am not sure if it makes any difference in my skin but it helps adding serum before I moisturize.

I used this on my wedding day. It made me glow! The skin look is the face mask + setting powder and blush. I don't use the masks often because I tend to get pimples the next day. It's probably because I never do moisturizer in the summer, just soap for my greasy face. Moisturizer is a winter activity for me. Could have invested in teeth whitening lol.
